description:
Hassle-free screen blackout and awake modes that keep your PC, Apps & AI ticking.

KiT is a quiet Windows companion that keeps your session awake (Light) or
darkens the desktop without sleeping the PC (Night); Off returns ordinary
Windows. One gesture each: Ctrl+Shift+D for Light, Ctrl+Shift+K for Night,
hold either for Off.

Night has four screensaver faces (Cosmos, DVD, Snake, Orbit), or quiet Off,
or Monitor off, which turns your displays off to save power while everything
else keeps running. A touch of activity brings you back.

Optional Ghost bar (transparent, click-through), Hold Night, Auto after idle,
Night brightness and run at sign-in. Remembers how you left it. Single
instance. Checks for updates only when you ask. Entirely local. No account.
No telemetry. No fake input.
